strings.about.description:
ZagoSheetsWin {version} - Zagotools

ZagoSheetsWin an gina shi bisa Open in Google, na Swati K (SwatiK425). Zagotools ne ke haɓaka shi kuma ana rarraba shi ƙarƙashin lasisin MIT.

Haƙƙin mallaka: 2026 Swati K da 2026 Zagotools. An kiyaye asalin yabo da lasisi.

Buɗe maƙunsar bayanai daga kwamfutarka sannan ka ci gaba a Google Sheets.

Bayan shigo da ita da tabbatarwa, manhajar tana adana ajiyar bayan asali sannan ta ƙirƙiri gajeriyar hanya a wurin fayil ɗin.

strings.setup.connectionPrivacy:
Sirrin haɗin Google
ZagoSheetsWin yana amfani da izinin drive.file kawai don ƙirƙira da sarrafa fayilolin da ake amfani da su da manhajar. Bayanan shiga suna zama a wannan kwamfutar, Windows na kare su, kuma ana aika maƙunsar bayananka kai tsaye zuwa APIs na Google - ba sa wucewa ta sabar Zagotools.
